title: Nvidia’s CEO Search Draws Fire With Bessent’s Call for ‘Shakeup’

title: Canaccord Says to Sell UK Wealth Arm to Centerbridge, Mubadala

title: Third US carrier joins Iran blockade, Bessent warns of economic collapse
summary: A third US aircraft carrier arrived in the Middle East Sunday, joining forces enforcing a blockade of Iranian ports, while Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent warned of a historic economic collapse in Iran, predicting a 25 percent contraction over the coming year.
